title: cancelled_order_ex_fiance_dinner
display_title: I cancelled my order and walked out during dinner with my ex-fiancé's family — AITAH?
beats: I cancelled my $34 order and walked out of the restaurant while my ex-fiancé's family was still mid-toast.
Backstory: we broke up eight months ago, but his mom still invites me to family dinners because she 'refuses to lose me too.'
Tonight his new girlfriend showed up, and his mom sat her directly across from me like nothing was strange.
I ordered anyway, smiled through appetizers, until his dad raised a glass and said 'to the future Mrs. Carter' — and nodded at her.
I stood up, told the waiter to cancel my order, and walked two blocks to get tacos alone in my car.
His mom texted me 'you humiliated us' twenty minutes later, and I still haven't answered. AITAH?
